name: Kingdom of Naples (Napoleonic)
alt: Kingdom of Naples under Joseph Bonaparte and Murat

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Naples (Bourbon)
predecessors.text: the mainland of the Bourbon Kingdom of Naples, taken by the French in February 1806 (Capua on 6 February, Joseph Bonaparte in Naples on 15 February)

successors.name: Kingdom of the Two Sicilies
successors.text: the mainland kingdom, restored to Ferdinand after 'On 23 May, the main Austrian army entered Naples'

ledger.x: 30 March 1806: Napoleon makes his brother Joseph King of Naples.
October 1808: Capri taken from the British.
15 March 1815: Murat declares war on Austria.
April 1815: Murat's army holds Bologna and the Marche.
By 8 April 1815: Neapolitan troops are in Florence.
May 1815: the Neapolitan troops leave the Marche and Bologna after Tolentino; the page gives no withdrawal date.
23 May 1815: the Austrians enter Naples and the Napoleonic kingdom ends.

wars.name: French conquest of the Kingdom of Naples (1806)
wars.outcome: The French took Capua on 6 February and Naples on 15 February 1806; Napoleon proclaimed Joseph King on 30 March; Gaeta fell after almost five months; the British won at Maida on 4 July; the Bourbons kept Sicily.

wars.name: Neapolitan War
wars.outcome: Murat declared war on 15 March 1815, took Bologna on 3 April, failed to cross the Po on 8 April, was beaten at Tolentino on 2-3 May and sued for peace at Casalanza on 20 May; the Austrians entered Naples on 23 May and Ferdinand was restored.

certainty.note: No treaty line is on the pages opened for the Papal frontier; Calabria was held against a British-backed resistance in 1806; the sea frontier with Sicily is sharp.
